#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build UI Kit for Deadlock: the runtime and its hook into the HUD.

    python3 build.py [--game <Deadlock folder>] [--release] [--hook perfstats|base_hud] [--probe [--probe-anywhere]]
                     [--survey SECONDS] [--autopilot herotesting|botmatch]

Writes dist/uikit_dir.vpk (install it with install.py) and readable copies of everything it
generated in dist/preview. Re-run after a game update: the hook is patched into the game's own
current layout. Packs are built into VPKs of their own by pack.py; build_pack() is here.

The hook: the runtime script is included by hud_perfstats_basics, the small layout of the FPS / ping
overlay that hud.xml always creates inside the HUD. No other known mod replaces it, so UI Kit can be
installed next to HUD Fit, Threat HUD and QOL Lock (they replace base_hud or hud.xml). --hook
base_hud uses base_hud instead, like HUD Fit.

--probe builds in the development-only data probe (probe/data_probe.js): it copies stock HUD parts and
reads the game's values to find out what packs can use. It runs in Hero Testing only, or in any match
with --probe-anywhere (meant for bot matches). Never for releases.

--survey builds in the data survey (probe/survey.js, development only): every value, game-filled label,
bar and state class of the stock HUD's layouts (survey.py lists them from the game's files), located
and sampled during a match. --autopilot adds probe/autopilot.js, which starts Hero Testing or a private
bot match from the main menu, plays a sandbox scenario and quits the game: autotest.py runs it
unattended.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "tools"))

import packs as packmod  # noqa: E402
import resource  # noqa: E402  (tools/resource.py)
import survey as surveymod  # noqa: E402
import vpk  # noqa: E402
from compilers import (MOD_SEARCH_PATH, BuildError, compile_css, compile_js, compile_layout,  # noqa: E402
                       compile_new_layout, compile_svg, insert, patch_defines)
from game import Game, find_game  # noqa: E402

JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit"              # + .vjs
PROBE_JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit_probe"  # + .vjs, probe builds only
SURVEY_JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit_survey"        # + .vjs, survey builds only
AUTOPILOT_JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit_autopilot"  # + .vjs, autopilot builds only
CHANNEL_JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit_channel"      # + .vjs, channel probe builds only
REPARENT_JS_RES = "panorama/scripts/uikit_reparent"    # + .vjs, move probe builds only
AUTOPILOT_RES = "panorama/layout/uikit/autopilot"      # + .vxml: its buttons
ROOT_RES = "panorama/layout/uikit/root"        # + .vxml: loaded into the kit root
ROOT_CSS_RES = "panorama/styles/uikit/root"    # + .vcss: its stylesheet
HUD_LAYOUT = "panorama/layout/hud.vxml_c"      # the stock HUD, for its panel ids
HOOKS = {
    "perfstats": "panorama/layout/hud_perfstats_basics.vxml_c",   # core pak01
    "base_hud": "panorama/layout/base_hud.vxml_c",
}
LAYOUT_TEMPLATE = "panorama/layout/base_hud.vxml_c"
CSS_TEMPLATE = "panorama/styles/citadel_hero_grid.vcss_c"
SVG_TEMPLATE = "panorama/images/control_icons/24px/refresh.vsvg_c"
RUNTIME = os.path.join(HERE, "runtime", "uikit.js")
PROBE = os.path.join(HERE, "probe", "data_probe.js")
SURVEY = os.path.join(HERE, "probe", "survey.js")
AUTOPILOT = os.path.join(HERE, "probe", "autopilot.js")
CHANNEL = os.path.join(HERE, "probe", "channel_probe.js")
REPARENT = os.path.join(HERE, "probe", "reparent_probe.js")
LIVE = os.path.join(HERE, "runtime", "live.js")
INSPECT = os.path.join(HERE, "runtime", "inspect.js")   # with live: pick a HUD panel, live.py shows its selectors
LIVE_RELAY = "https://greeb.github.io/uikit-relay/"   # GREEB/uikit-relay; the game's browser only loads https
LIVE_PORT = 8765
AUTOPILOTS = ("herotesting", "botmatch")
PACKS_DIR = os.path.join(HERE, "packs")
DIST = os.path.join(HERE, "dist")
PACK_DIST = os.path.join(DIST, "packs")
RUNTIME_VERSION = re.search(r'var VERSION = "([^"]+)"', packmod.read_text(RUNTIME)).group(1)

# The kit root's own layout: puts the shop and scoreboard state on the kit root for every widget
# (.gShopOpen .MyWidget), with one listener instead of one per widget (verified in game).
ROOT_LAYOUT = """<root>
	<styles>
		<include src="s2r://%s.vcss" />
	</styles>
	<Panel class="UIKitRoot" hittest="false">
		<GlobalClassListener classes="gShopOpen gScoreboardOpen" />
	</Panel>
</root>
""" % ROOT_CSS_RES

# The autopilot's hidden buttons: what the main menu's Hero Testing button, its private bot match
# button (easy bots; the other bot button queues with other players and is never used), the
# Hero Testing panel's console buttons and the shop's category tabs run.
AUTOPILOT_LAYOUT = """<root>
	<Panel hittest="false">
		<Button id="UIKitAutoHeroTesting" onactivate="CitadelStartHeroTesting( false )" />
		<Button id="UIKitAutoBotMatch" onactivate="CitadelStartBotMatch( true, k_ECitadelGameMode_Normal, k_ECitadelBotDifficulty_Easy )" />
		<Button id="UIKitAutoQuit" onactivate="CitadelConCommand( 'quit' )" />
		<Button id="UIKitAutoShopWeapon" onactivate="CitadelSelectShopTab( EShopTab_Weapon )" />
		<Button id="UIKitAutoShopVitality" onactivate="CitadelSelectShopTab( EShopTab_Vitality )" />
		<Button id="UIKitAutoShopSpirit" onactivate="CitadelSelectShopTab( EShopTab_Spirit )" />
	</Panel>
</root>
"""

# In the main menu the HUD has InHideout and hud.css hides each of its parts; widgets go with them.
ROOT_CSS = """.InHideout .UIKitRoot
{
	visibility: collapse;
}
"""


def patch_hook(xml, extra=()):
    """Include the runtime script (and development scripts after it); nothing else changes."""
    includes = ['\t<include src="s2r://%s.vjs_c" />' % res for res in [JS_RES] + list(extra)]
    if "<scripts>" in xml:
        return insert(xml, "<scripts>", "\n".join(includes))
    return insert(xml, "</styles>", "<scripts>\n%s\n</scripts>" % "\n".join(includes))


def fill(js, name, value):
    js, count = re.subn(r"/\*__%s__\*/.*?/\*__END__\*/" % name,
                        lambda m: json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")), js, flags=re.S)
    if count != 1:
        raise BuildError("placeholder %s not found in the runtime" % name)
    return js


def stock_ids(game):
    """Panel ids in the game's hud.xml: widgets mustn't reuse them (panels are found by id)."""
    try:
        return set(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"', game.layout(HUD_LAYOUT)))
    except BuildError:
        return set()


def pack_files(game, pack):
    """Every file of one pack's VPK: entry layout, slot markers, widget layouts, stylesheets, images, and
    a manifest for tools."""
    files, previews = {}, {}
    layout_t, css_t, svg_t = game.read(LAYOUT_TEMPLATE), game.read(CSS_TEMPLATE), game.read(SVG_TEMPLATE)

    entry = pack.entry_layout()
    files[pack.entry_res + ".vxml_c"] = compile_new_layout(layout_t, entry, pack.entry_res, [])
    previews["pack_%s.xml" % pack.slot] = entry
    for res in pack.markers:
        files[res + ".vsvg_c"] = compile_svg(svg_t, packmod.MARKER_SVG, res, MOD_SEARCH_PATH)

    stylesheets = {}
    if os.path.isfile(pack.pack_css):
        stylesheets[pack.pack_css_res] = pack.pack_css
    for w in pack.widgets:
        files[w.res + ".vxml_c"] = compile_new_layout(layout_t, w.xml, w.res, pack.references(w))
        previews["%s.xml" % w.name] = w.xml
        if os.path.isfile(w.source_css):
            stylesheets[w.css_res] = w.source_css
    for res, path in stylesheets.items():
        css = pack.resolve_images(pack.apply_vars(packmod.read_text(path), os.path.relpath(path, pack.folder)))
        try:
            files[res + ".vcss_c"] = compile_css(css_t, css, res)
        except BuildError as e:
            raise BuildError("%s: %s" % (os.path.relpath(path), e))
        previews["%s.css" % res.rsplit("/", 1)[1]] = css
    for name in pack.images:
        svg = packmod.read_text(os.path.join(pack.folder, "images", name + ".svg"))
        files[pack.image_res(name) + ".vsvg_c"] = compile_svg(svg_t, svg, pack.image_res(name), MOD_SEARCH_PATH)
    known, patched = None, {}
    for name in pack.themes:
        layout_res, src, css_res = packmod.theme_res(name), pack.theme_source(name), pack.theme_css_res(name)
        try:
            original, xml = game.read(layout_res + ".vxml_c"), game.layout(layout_res + ".vxml_c")
        except (BuildError, KeyError):
            raise BuildError(pack.where("theme/%s.css: the game has no layout layout/%s.xml to restyle" % (name, name)))
        theme = pack.resolve_images(pack.apply_vars(packmod.read_text(src), "theme/%s.css" % name))
        try:
            files[css_res + ".vcss_c"] = compile_css(css_t, theme, css_res)
        except BuildError as e:
            raise BuildError("%s: %s" % (os.path.relpath(src), e))
        # the theme's stylesheet goes last, after the game's own: where both match, the theme wins
        include = '\t<include src="s2r://%s.vcss" />' % css_res
        xml_patched = insert(xml, "</styles>", include, before=True) if "</styles>" in xml else \
            insert(xml, "<root>", "<styles>\n%s\n</styles>" % include)
        files[layout_res + ".vxml_c"] = compile_layout(original, xml_patched, [css_res + ".vcss"])
        patched[layout_res + ".vxml_c"] = crc_hex(original)
        known = known or hud_names(game)
        ids, classes = packmod.selector_names(theme)
        unknown = sorted(["#" + i for i in ids - known[0]] + ["." + c for c in classes - known[1]])
        if unknown:
            pack.warn("theme/%s.css: no HUD layout or stylesheet has %s (a typo?)" % (name, ", ".join(unknown[:8])))
        # A panel another layout creates is styled by that layout's stylesheets, which win over these.
        for i in sorted(packmod.selector_targets(theme) - known[2].get(name, set())):
            owners = sorted(other for other, declared in known[2].items() if i in declared)
            if owners:
                pack.warn("theme/%s.css: #%s is created by layout/%s.xml%s, whose own stylesheets win over this file "
                          "for it: put its rules in theme/%s.css" % (name, i, owners[0], " (and %d more)" % (len(owners) - 1)
                                                                     if len(owners) > 1 else "", owners[0]))
        previews["theme_%s.css" % name.replace("/", "_")] = theme
        previews["%s.xml" % name.replace("/", "_")] = xml_patched
    if pack.defines:
        files_defines, notes = pack_defines(game, pack, patched)
        files.update(files_defines)
        previews["defines.txt"] = notes
    manifest = json.dumps(pack.manifest(RUNTIME_VERSION, game.version(), patched), indent=2) + "\n"
    files[pack.manifest_path] = manifest.encode("utf-8")
    previews["manifest.json"] = manifest
    return files, previews


# The game's stylesheets whose @define constants a pack's "defines" can change: every layout includes the
# base styles (fonts like sans/oracle/block, colours like offWhite), the HUD's include hud_common (team colours).
DEFINE_SHEETS = ["panorama/styles/citadel_base_styles.vcss_c", "panorama/styles/hud_common.vcss_c"]


def crc_hex(body):
    return "%08x" % zlib.crc32(body)


def pack_defines(game, pack, patched):
    """The game stylesheets with the pack's "defines" applied; ({path: body}, notes for the preview).
    Adds each replaced file to `patched`."""
    files, notes, left = {}, [], set(pack.defines)
    for path in DEFINE_SHEETS:
        try:
            original = game.read(path)
        except (BuildError, KeyError):
            continue
        try:
            body, old = patch_defines(original, pack.defines)
        except BuildError as e:
            raise BuildError(pack.where("%s (%s)" % (e, path)))
        if body is None:
            continue
        files[path], patched[path] = body, crc_hex(original)
        left -= set(old)
        notes += ["%s: %s %r -> %r" % (path, n, old[n], pack.defines[n]) for n in sorted(old)]
    if left:
        raise BuildError(pack.where("defines: the game defines no %s (only constants of %s can be changed)"
                                    % (", ".join(sorted(left)), " and ".join(p.rsplit("/", 1)[1][:-7] + ".css" for p in DEFINE_SHEETS))))
    return files, "\n".join(notes) + "\n"


HOOKS_BASE = "panorama/layout/base_hud.vxml_c"   # where the HUD's top panel, CitadelHud#Hud, is declared


def hud_names(game):
    """Every id and class in the game's HUD and shop layouts and stylesheets, to spot typos in themes:
    ({ids}, {classes}, {layout name: {ids it declares}})."""
    ids, classes, by_layout, sources = set(), set(), {}, {}
    for path in game.names("panorama/layout/"):
        if surveymod.HUD_LAYOUT_RE.match(path) or packmod.THEME_LAYOUT_RE.match(path) or path == HOOKS_BASE:
            try:
                xml = game.layout(path)
            except (BuildError, KeyError):
                continue
            declared = set(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"', xml))
            name = path[len("panorama/layout/"):-len(".vxml_c")]
            by_layout[name] = declared
            sources[name] = xml
            ids |= declared
            for c in re.findall(r'\bclass="([^"]+)"', xml):
                classes |= set(c.split())
    for path in game.names("panorama/styles/"):
        if path.endswith(".vcss_c") and packmod.THEME_STYLE_RE.search(path):
            try:
                i, c = packmod.selector_names(resource.get_block(game.read(path), b"DATA")[6:].decode("utf-8", "replace"))
            except (BuildError, KeyError):
                continue
            ids |= i
            classes |= c
    merged_into(by_layout, sources)
    return ids, classes, by_layout


GENERIC_TAGS = {"Panel", "Label", "Image", "Button", "TextButton", "ToggleButton", "RadioButton", "GlobalClassListener",
                "ProgressBar", "ProgressBarWithMiddle", "CircularProgressBar"}


def merged_into(by_layout, sources):
    """A component's layout merges its top panel into the panel that loads it: the souls part's layout
    (hud_gold_and_ap_container, top panel CitadelHudSoulAPContainer) styles hud.xml's
    <CitadelHudSoulAPContainer id="gold_and_ap_container">. Add those ids to the layout's own (verified in game:
    a rule for #gold_and_ap_container in theme/hud_gold_and_ap_container.css works)."""
    by_tag = {}
    for xml in sources.values():
        for tag, i in re.findall(r'<(\w+)\b[^>]*?\bid="([^"]+)"', xml):
            by_tag.setdefault(tag, set()).add(i)
    for name, xml in sources.items():
        m = re.search(r"<root>\s*(?:<(?:styles|scripts|snippets)>.*?</(?:styles|scripts|snippets)>\s*)*<(\w+)", xml, re.S)
        if m and m.group(1) not in GENERIC_TAGS:
            by_layout[name] = by_layout[name] | by_tag.get(m.group(1), set())


def runtime_files(game, debug=True, hook="perfstats", probe=None, survey=None, autopilot=None, channel=None, live=None, reparent=False):
    """The runtime's files: the patched hook layout, the script, the kit root's layout and stylesheet,
    and development scripts: the data probe ({"anywhere": bool}), the survey ({"seconds": n,
    "anywhere": bool}) and the autopilot ({"start": "herotesting" or "botmatch", "seconds": n})."""
    extra = []
    if probe is not None:
        extra.append((PROBE_JS_RES, PROBE, {"UKP_OPTIONS": probe}))
    if survey is not None:
        extra.append((SURVEY_JS_RES, SURVEY, {"UKS_OPTIONS": survey, "UKS_SPEC": surveymod.spec(game)}))
    if autopilot is not None:
        if autopilot.get("start") not in AUTOPILOTS:
            raise BuildError("the autopilot starts one of: " + ", ".join(AUTOPILOTS))
        extra.append((AUTOPILOT_JS_RES, AUTOPILOT, {"UKA_OPTIONS": autopilot}))
    if channel is not None:
        extra.append((CHANNEL_JS_RES, CHANNEL, {"UKC_OPTIONS": channel}))
    if reparent:
        extra.append((REPARENT_JS_RES, REPARENT, {}))
    hook_res = HOOKS[hook]
    hook_xml = patch_hook(game.layout(hook_res), [res for res, _, _ in extra])
    js = packmod.read_text(RUNTIME)
    js = fill(js, "UK_DEBUG", bool(debug))
    js = fill(js, "UK_MOUNTS", {m: spec["panel"] for m, spec in packmod.MOUNTS.items()})
    js = fill(js, "UK_BINDS", packmod.runtime_binds())
    js = fill(js, "UK_SIZED", sorted(t for t, info in packmod.NATIVE.items() if info.get("size")))
    if live is not None:
        # live preview for authors (live.py): never in a normal build, which loads no web page at all
        options = {"relay": live.get("relay", LIVE_RELAY), "port": int(live.get("port", LIVE_PORT)), "every": 0.25,
                   "selftest": bool(live.get("selftest"))}   # selftest: autotest.py's inspector check
        js = js.replace("/*__UK_LIVE__*/", fill(packmod.read_text(LIVE), "UK_LIVE_OPTIONS", options) + "\n" +
                        packmod.read_text(INSPECT), 1)
    refs = [JS_RES + ".vjs"] + [res + ".vjs" for res, _, _ in extra]
    files = {
        hook_res: compile_layout(game.read(hook_res), hook_xml, refs),
        JS_RES + ".vjs_c": compile_js(js, JS_RES),
        ROOT_RES + ".vxml_c": compile_new_layout(game.read(LAYOUT_TEMPLATE), ROOT_LAYOUT, ROOT_RES, [ROOT_CSS_RES + ".vcss"]),
        ROOT_CSS_RES + ".vcss_c": compile_css(game.read(CSS_TEMPLATE), ROOT_CSS, ROOT_CSS_RES),
    }
    previews = {os.path.basename(hook_res)[:-len(".vxml_c")] + ".xml": hook_xml, "uikit.js": js, "root.xml": ROOT_LAYOUT,
                "root.css": ROOT_CSS}
    for res, source, fills in extra:
        js = packmod.read_text(source)
        for name, value in fills.items():
            js = fill(js, name, value)
        files[res + ".vjs_c"] = compile_js(js, res)
        previews[res.rsplit("/", 1)[1] + ".js"] = js
    if autopilot is not None:
        files[AUTOPILOT_RES + ".vxml_c"] = compile_new_layout(game.read(LAYOUT_TEMPLATE), AUTOPILOT_LAYOUT, AUTOPILOT_RES, [])
        previews["autopilot.xml"] = AUTOPILOT_LAYOUT
    return files, previews


def write_vpk(files, previews, out, preview_dir):
    """Pack files into the VPK at out; readable copies of the generated text go to preview_dir."""
    stage = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="uikit_stage_")
    try:
        for rel, body in files.items():
            dst = os.path.join(stage, rel)
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
            with open(dst, "wb") as f:
                f.write(body)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out), exist_ok=True)
        vpk.pack(stage, out)
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    shutil.rmtree(preview_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    for name, text in previews.items():
        dst = os.path.join(preview_dir, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
        with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
    return out


def build(game_dir, debug=True, hook="perfstats", probe=None, survey=None, autopilot=None, channel=None, live=None,
          reparent=False):
    return build_game(Game(game_dir), debug, hook, probe=probe, survey=survey, autopilot=autopilot, channel=channel,
                      live=live, reparent=reparent)


def build_game(game, debug=True, hook="perfstats", dist=DIST, probe=None, survey=None, autopilot=None, channel=None,
               live=None, reparent=False):
    """The runtime's VPK, from a Game (anything with read(path), layout(path), names(prefix) and version())."""
    files, previews = runtime_files(game, debug, hook, probe, survey, autopilot, channel, live, reparent)
    out = write_vpk(files, previews, os.path.join(dist, "uikit_dir.vpk"), os.path.join(dist, "preview"))
    return {"vpk": out, "files": files, "game_version": game.version(), "hook": HOOKS[hook], "probe": probe,
            "survey": survey, "autopilot": autopilot, "version": RUNTIME_VERSION}


def build_pack(game, folder, dist=PACK_DIST):
    """One pack's VPK: dist/<id>_dir.vpk, with readable copies in dist/<id>/."""
    pack = packmod.load_pack(folder, stock_ids(game))
    files, previews = pack_files(game, pack)
    out = write_vpk(files, previews, os.path.join(dist, pack.id + "_dir.vpk"), os.path.join(dist, pack.id))
    return {"vpk": out, "files": files, "pack": pack, "warnings": pack.warnings, "game_version": game.version()}


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--game", help="path to the Deadlock install folder")
    ap.add_argument("--release", action="store_true", help="no diagnostic logging")
    ap.add_argument("--hook", choices=sorted(HOOKS), default="perfstats", help="layout that loads the runtime")
    ap.add_argument("--probe", action="store_true", help="build in the development-only data probe")
    ap.add_argument("--probe-anywhere", action="store_true", help="with --probe: run in any match, not just Hero Testing")
    ap.add_argument("--survey", type=int, metavar="SECONDS", help="build in the data survey, running this long in a match")
    ap.add_argument("--autopilot", choices=AUTOPILOTS, help="build in the autopilot (for autotest.py)")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    probe = {"anywhere": args.probe_anywhere} if args.probe or args.probe_anywhere else None
    survey = {"seconds": args.survey, "anywhere": True} if args.survey else None
    autopilot = {"start": args.autopilot, "seconds": (args.survey or 300) + 240} if args.autopilot else None
    try:
        result = build(find_game(args.game), debug=not args.release, hook=args.hook, probe=probe, survey=survey,
                       autopilot=autopilot)
    except BuildError as e:
        print("build failed: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print("UI Kit %s for game version %s, hook %s" % (result["version"], result["game_version"], result["hook"]))
    for rel, body in sorted(result["files"].items()):
        print("  %7d  %s" % (len(body), rel))
    print("wrote %s (packs are built with pack.py)" % result["vpk"])
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Make, build and install UI Kit packs. A pack is a folder with a pack.json (see docs/packs.md); each
builds into a VPK of its own that works with any installed UI Kit that is new enough.

    python3 pack.py new <id> [--dir <parent folder>] [--name "My HUD"] [--author me]
                                          start a pack from the template
    python3 pack.py build <folder>...     check it and build <id>_dir.vpk into dist/packs/ (plus readable copies)
    python3 pack.py install <folder or _dir.vpk>...
                                          build if needed, then copy into the game's addons as a pakNN
    python3 pack.py remove <id>...        remove installed packs
    python3 pack.py list                  installed UI Kit, packs and other addon files, and files one
                                          addon hides from another
    python3 pack.py files [pakNN]...      the files in addon VPKs

Building needs Deadlock installed (the game's own files are the templates for the compiled ones).
--game <Deadlock folder> if it isn't found by itself. Close the game before installing or removing.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "tools"))

import addons  # noqa: E402
import build  # noqa: E402
import packs as packmod  # noqa: E402
import vpk  # noqa: E402
from compilers import BuildError  # noqa: E402
from game import Game, find_game  # noqa: E402

TEMPLATE = os.path.join(HERE, "template")


def new_pack(pack_id, parent, name=None, author=None):
    """Copy the template into <parent>/<pack_id>, filled in; returns the folder."""
    if not packmod.ID_RE.match(pack_id):
        raise BuildError("pack id %r: use 1-32 lowercase letters, digits and _ (start it with your name, like "
                         "greeb_minimal, so it stays unique)" % pack_id)
    folder = os.path.join(parent, pack_id)
    if os.path.exists(folder):
        raise BuildError("%s already exists" % folder)
    values = {"id": pack_id, "name": name or pack_id.replace("_", " ").title(), "author": author or "you"}
    for root, _, names in os.walk(TEMPLATE):
        for n in names:
            src = os.path.join(root, n)
            dst = os.path.join(folder, os.path.relpath(src, TEMPLATE))
            os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(dst), exist_ok=True)
            text = packmod.read_text(src)
            text = re.sub(r"\{\{(id|name|author)\}\}",
                          lambda m: json.dumps(values[m.group(1)])[1:-1] if n.endswith(".json") else values[m.group(1)], text)
            with open(dst, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(text)
    return folder


def vpk_manifest(path):
    """The manifest inside a built pack VPK."""
    entries, base = vpk.read_index(path)
    for rel in entries:
        if addons.MANIFEST_RE.match(rel):
            return json.loads(vpk.read_file(path, entries[rel], base).decode("utf-8"))
    raise BuildError("%s is not a UI Kit pack (no uikit/packs/<id>.json inside)" % path)


def replaced(manifest):
    """The game files a pack's VPK replaces with changed copies (themes' layouts, stylesheets with new
    defines). Manifests from before "patched" only list the themes."""
    files = set(manifest.get("patched") or {})
    return files | {"panorama/layout/%s.vxml_c" % t for t in manifest.get("theme", [])}


def outdated(game, manifest):
    """The files a pack replaces that a game update has changed since the pack was built: its copies are of
    the old ones, so it needs rebuilding."""
    stale = []
    for path, crc in sorted((manifest.get("patched") or {}).items()):
        try:
            now = build.crc_hex(game.read(path))
        except (BuildError, KeyError, OSError):
            now = None
        if now != crc:
            stale.append(path)
    return stale


def outdated_lines(game, folder):
    lines = []
    for pid, pak in sorted(addons.installed_packs(folder).items()):
        stale = outdated(game, pak.manifest)
        if stale:
            lines.append("warning: pack %s (%s) carries copies of %d game file%s that the game has changed since "
                         "(%s%s): rebuild and install it again, or that part of the HUD may break"
                         % (pid, pak.name, len(stale), "" if len(stale) == 1 else "s", ", ".join(stale[:3]),
                            ", ..." if len(stale) > 3 else ""))
    return lines


def install_pack(game_dir, folder_or_vpk, game=None, dist=build.PACK_DIST):
    """Build (for a folder) and install one pack; returns lines to print."""
    out = []
    if os.path.isdir(folder_or_vpk):
        result = build.build_pack(game or Game(game_dir), folder_or_vpk, dist)
        out += ["warning: " + w for w in result["warnings"]]
        src = result["vpk"]
    elif folder_or_vpk.endswith(".vpk") and os.path.isfile(folder_or_vpk):
        src = folder_or_vpk
    else:
        raise BuildError("%s is neither a pack folder nor a pack VPK" % folder_or_vpk)
    manifest = vpk_manifest(src)
    folder = addons.addons_dir(game_dir)
    installed = addons.installed_packs(folder)
    for pid, pak in installed.items():
        if pid != manifest["id"] and pak.manifest.get("slot") == manifest["slot"]:
            raise BuildError("pack %s and the installed pack %s (%s) share slot %s: only one of them would load. "
                             "One of them needs another id." % (manifest["id"], pid, pak.name, manifest["slot"]))
    mine = replaced(manifest)
    for pid, pak in installed.items():
        both = sorted(mine & replaced(pak.manifest)) if pid != manifest["id"] else []
        if both:
            raise BuildError("pack %s and the installed pack %s (%s) both change %s: only one would win. Remove %s first "
                             "(python3 pack.py remove %s)." % (manifest["id"], pid, pak.name, ", ".join(both), pid, pid))
    runtime = addons.runtime(folder)
    if not runtime:
        out.append("note: UI Kit itself isn't installed, so packs do nothing yet: python3 install.py")
    elif packmod.version_tuple(manifest.get("needs", "0")) > packmod.version_tuple(runtime.runtime_version):
        out.append("note: this pack needs UI Kit %s or newer, %s is installed: update it with python3 install.py"
                   % (manifest["needs"], runtime.runtime_version))
    same = installed.get(manifest["id"])
    number = same.number if same else addons.free_number(folder)
    name = addons.install(folder, src, number)
    out.append("%s pack %s %s as %s" % ("updated" if same else "installed", manifest["id"], manifest.get("version", "?"), name))
    return out


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("command", choices=["new", "build", "install", "remove", "list", "files"])
    ap.add_argument("targets", nargs="*", help="pack id (new, remove) or pack folders / VPKs (build, install)")
    ap.add_argument("--game", help="path to the Deadlock install folder")
    ap.add_argument("--dir", default=".", help="new: where to create the pack folder (default: here)")
    ap.add_argument("--name", help="new: the pack's display name")
    ap.add_argument("--author", help="new: your name")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    try:
        if args.command == "new":
            if len(args.targets) != 1:
                ap.error("new takes one pack id")
            folder = new_pack(args.targets[0], args.dir, args.name, args.author)
            print("created %s\nnext: edit it, then python3 pack.py install %s (guide: docs/packs.md)" % (folder, folder))
            return 0

        game_dir = find_game(args.game)
        if args.command == "list":
            folder = addons.addons_dir(game_dir)
            runtime = addons.runtime(folder)
            print("UI Kit %s" % ("%s installed as %s" % (runtime.runtime_version, runtime.name) if runtime else "not installed"))
            for pid, pak in sorted(addons.installed_packs(folder).items()):
                m = pak.manifest
                print("  pack %-24s %-10s %-14s slot %s, %s" % (pid, m.get("version", "?"), ("by " + m["author"]) if m.get("author") else "",
                                                                m.get("slot", "?"), pak.name))
            print("addon files:\n" + "\n".join(addons.describe(folder)))
            for line in addons.shadow_lines(folder) + outdated_lines(Game(game_dir), folder):
                print(line)
            return 0
        if args.command == "files":
            folder = addons.addons_dir(game_dir)
            for pak in addons.scan(folder):
                if args.targets and pak.name[:-len("_dir.vpk")] not in args.targets and pak.name not in args.targets:
                    continue
                print("%s (%s): %d files" % (pak.name, pak.kind(), len(pak.entries or {})))
                for rel in sorted(pak.entries or {}):
                    print("  " + rel)
            return 0
        if not args.targets:
            ap.error("%s needs at least one pack" % args.command)
        if args.command == "build":
            game = Game(game_dir)
            for target in args.targets:
                result = build.build_pack(game, target)
                for w in result["warnings"]:
                    print("warning: " + w)
                p = result["pack"]
                print("built %s %s (slot %s, %d files) into %s" % (p.id, p.version, p.slot, len(result["files"]), result["vpk"]))
            return 0
        if args.command == "install":
            game = Game(game_dir)
            for target in args.targets:
                print("\n".join(install_pack(game_dir, target, game)))
            folder = addons.addons_dir(game_dir)
            print("\n".join(addons.describe(folder)))
            packs_here = {p.name for p in addons.installed_packs(folder).values()}
            for line in addons.shadow_lines(folder, packs_here) + outdated_lines(game, folder):
                print(line)
            return 0
        if args.command == "remove":
            folder = addons.addons_dir(game_dir)
            for pid in args.targets:
                pak = addons.installed_packs(folder).get(pid)
                if not pak:
                    print("pack %s isn't installed" % pid)
                    continue
                print("pack %s: %s" % (pid, addons.remove(folder, pak.number)))
            print("\n".join(addons.describe(folder)))
            return 0
    except BuildError as e:
        print("failed: %s" % e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except PermissionError:
        print("could not write to the game folder. Close Deadlock and try again.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Source 2 compiled resource container (*_c) helpers."""
import struct


def read_blocks(data):
    """Return list of (type, bytes) in file order."""
    size, hv, ver, boff, bcnt = struct.unpack_from("<IHHII", data, 0)
    pos = 8 + boff
    out = []
    for _ in range(bcnt):
        t = data[pos:pos + 4]
        off, sz = struct.unpack_from("<II", data, pos + 4)
        out.append((t, data[pos + 4 + off:pos + 4 + off + sz]))
        pos += 12
    return (hv, ver), out


def get_block(data, name):
    for t, b in read_blocks(data)[1]:
        if t == name:
            return b
    return None


def write_blocks(version, blocks):
    """Serialize blocks back into a resource file. version = (header_version, type_version)."""
    hv, ver = version
    n = len(blocks)
    table_off = 16
    data_off = table_off + 12 * n
    body = bytearray()
    entries = []
    pos = data_off
    for t, b in blocks:
        pad = (-pos) % 16
        body += b"\0" * pad
        pos += pad
        entries.append((t, pos, len(b)))
        body += b
        pos += len(b)
    out = bytearray(struct.pack("<IHHII", pos, hv, ver, 8, n))
    for i, (t, off, sz) in enumerate(entries):
        field = table_off + 12 * i + 4
        out += t + struct.pack("<II", off - field, sz)
    out += body
    assert len(out) == pos
    return bytes(out)


def split_panorama_data(data_block):
    """DATA block of vcss/vxml: crc u32, image count u16, image entries, then text.
    Returns (header_bytes, text_bytes)."""
    n = struct.unpack_from("<H", data_block, 4)[0]
    pos = 6
    for _ in range(n):
        pos = data_block.index(b"\0", pos) + 1 + 8
    return data_block[:pos], data_block[pos:]
